IO3_transformations.operation: Validate request, assign category, set urgency, geocode location, create record

P.P1_bottleneck_analysis: State machine transitions under concurrent claims
P.P2_defensibility: Standard state-machine pattern with optimistic locking
P.P5_backup_plan: Queue claims with DB-level locking. Auto-expire orphaned requests after 72h.
P.P6_backup_plan_test: Simulate failure scenario in staging with mock data
P.P7_testing_strategy: Unit test all state transitions. Integration test claim race conditions. Load test 1000 concurrent requests.

L.L1_legal_considerations: Request data retention per CCPA. Location data in requests uses user's sharing granularity.
L.L3_consent_requirements: Standard app consent covers request creation. Location recording consent separate.
L.L4_liability_notes: Beacon facilitates connection, not liable for help quality.

F.F1_cost_considerations: Minimal: DB writes + geospatial index. ~$0.001 per request.
F.F2_accounting_considerations: Allocated to help module operational budget

S.S1_cybersecurity: Input validation prevents XSS/injection. Rate limit: max 5 active requests per user.
S.S2_data_privacy: Request descriptions stored in plaintext (not E2E encrypted - visible on public feed). Location precision controlled by user settings.
S.S3_encryption_requirements: TLS in transit. DB encryption at rest.
S.S4_access_control: Any authenticated user can create. Only requester can resolve.
S.S5_audit_requirements: Log all state transitions with timestamps and actor IDs.
